pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal regions with jagged, high-contrast edges. The geometry transitions from larger, irregular tessellations on the neck and upper flank to smaller, more fragmented sub-circular clusters on the visible portion of the foreleg.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways with clear junction nodes. Pathways exhibit relatively uniform pixel thickness across the central flank, creating a high-connectivity topological graph.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the superior neck margin, visible as a distinct textural boundary against the background.
